P4 registration over the network freezes the snapshot server-side (1280 x 3)
P5 the order reaches verified over the network before the restart
P6 the first API process is terminated and leaves the database reopenable
P7 a second, independent API process starts against the same database file
P8 the resident session cookie still authenticates on the new process
P9 the order, its snapshot and the verification record survive the process restart
P10 the whole append-only timeline survives the process restart
P11 the idempotency key replays into the same order on the NEW process (no second row)
P12 the public catalogue still serves the product after the restart
P13 the second API process is terminated as well
P14 the process-restart temp directory was removed without EPERM
